== Title ==
<span lang="ja">脱出管制</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所に配備する。1ターンに1回、同じ惑星にある自分の「惑星防衛用イオン砲」を自分の移動フェイズに起動できる。加えて、同じ惑星の自分の中型輸送艇はそれぞれ航行速度＋2、耐：損耗＜3となり、フォースを消費せずに移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「全軍に撤退指令を出して……あなたも早く輸送艇に乗りなさい！」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Evacuation Control.

'''Lore''' — Issue the withdrawal order to all forces… and you get on a transport quickly too!

'''Game text''' — Deploy on your strategic command room or battle command post. Once per turn, your Planet Defender Ion Cannon at the same planet may fire during your move phase. Each of your medium transports at the same planet is hyperspeed +2 and immune to attrition less than 3. They may move without spending Force.

No uniqueness marker. War rooms print as 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所. The ion cannon is quoted as 惑星防衛用イオン砲. Fire is 起動できる. Medium transports are それぞれ航行速度＋2. Move for free is フォースを消費せずに.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-evacuationcontrol-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Evacuation Control]].</ref>
